glosses: to overweigh (to cause to weigh too much)
to overload, to overburden (to give too many duties)
to overload, to overburden (to use something for too long, e.g., a computer)
to overload (to place too much information somewhere)
to overload (to provide too much power to a circuit)
to overload oneself, to overburden oneself (to do something long- or short-term for too long and feel badly as a result)
to be overloaded, to be overburdened (to cease functioning as a result of operating or working too long)
to overload oneself, to overburden oneself (to take on too many duties)
to be overloaded, to be overburdened (to have too much placed onto oneself)
